root: Each real session startup took about 31 seconds; current host MCP transport deadline is 30 seconds. Client timeout first 15 seconds, then outer transport at 30 seconds interrupted synchronous constructors.
resolution: One official webdriver.Remote constructor in a retained Runtime Future, no capability or dependency changes; resolve same Future after external request completes.
endpointBoundary: Appium 3 server does not expose GET /sessions (404); individual observed session identities can be reconciled via GET /session/:id.
